classifications.label: Customer energy usage data
classifications.refusal: Interval usage is shown only in aggregate unless the customer consented or the role is cleared.

classifications.refusal: Grid and plant topology, capacity and SCADA detail are restricted to cleared operations and engineering roles.

classifications.label: Market-sensitive

classifications.label: Confidential
classifications.refusal: Confidential business data is available to internal roles with a business need.

otSafety.title: OT safety rule
otSafety.rule: No agent operates, or can be promoted to operate, grid, plant or gas control devices: switching, breakers, reclosers, set-points, valves or de-energisation. Any agent or process whose recommendation would change a grid, plant, storage or gas device is capped at L2 (Propose). Every switching plan, PSPS decision and hazardous-leak response is made and executed by qualified people.
otSafety.tooltip: Locked at L2 by the OT safety rule: this agent's recommendations would change a grid, plant, storage or gas device, so qualified people review and execute them. No agent operates control devices.
